title: Mid-Week Victory Through Faith and Action
description: In this powerful message, Pastor Chris Zehner exposes the enemy's tactics and reminds us that we are in a good warfare, one that we are destined to win every time. As we learn to stand strong in our faith and obey the word of God, we will find victory over Satan and mature spiritually. Join Pastor Chris as he reveals the keys to becoming a doer of the word and living a life of obedience and faith.
